subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit announcement remain open as a visible community policy notice now that the contribution guide and Barnacle automation already carry the 20-PR rule?
rationale: The repository implementation is complete, but the post-merge rename, reopen, and pin are maintainer-intent signals that cleanup automation should not override.

options.title: Keep The Pinned Notice
options.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the durable community-facing announcement for the 20-open-PR cap.

options.title: Close After Maintainer Confirmation
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide the contribution guide and automation are sufficient public notice.

options.title: Replace With A Canonical Policy Page
options.body: Move the announcement into a dedicated public policy page and close this issue after linking that destination.

recommendation.title: Keep The Pinned Notice
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the durable community-facing announcement for the 20-open-PR cap.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the key reopen, rename, and pin actions that changed this from a closed docs-tracking issue into an active policy notice.
